title: Documented limit: a token with no tenant is not isolated
what: A token that is not pinned to a tenant keeps the old, open behaviour and sees every tenant. That is by design (the primary token is the operator's); this scenario pins the documented fact so a change would be noticed. Pin every token you hand out.
limit: Documented in docs/token-namespaces.md: tokens with no pin are not tenant-scoped.

expect.desc: an unpinned token finds the tenant's note (documented, not a bug)
